mission.label: Our Mission
mission.title: Eliminating Human Risk in Industrial Maintenance
mission.text: Every year, thousands of workers are injured in high-altitude maintenance operations. Bezliny's autonomous drone platform replaces dangerous manual labor with precision robotic systems — delivering superior results while keeping people safe.

services.label: Solutions
services.title: Industrial-Grade Services
services.subtitle: From skyscrapers to offshore platforms — precision drone operations for every sector.
services.facadeDesc: Glass, concrete, and cladding — any height, no scaffolding required.
services.bridgeDesc: Cleaning and inspection of girders, decks, and supports without traffic disruption.
services.oilDesc: Offshore rigs, flare stacks, and storage tanks — preserving protective coatings.
services.windDesc: Blade cleaning and inspection at height — maximizing energy output.
services.shipDesc: Hull and superstructure maintenance above the waterline — in port or at sea.
services.inspectionDesc: Visual and thermal inspection of structures, pipelines, and equipment.

process.label: Process
process.title: How We Deliver
process.step01Desc: Comprehensive drone survey and structural analysis. Our engineers evaluate every surface, height, and environmental factor before any operation begins.
process.step02Desc: AI-driven flight path optimization. Every millimeter is calculated — pressure, temperature, water flow — for perfect results with zero surface damage.
process.step03Desc: GPS-RTK navigation with centimeter precision. Our drones operate fully autonomously while our operators monitor from a safe distance.
process.step04Desc: 4K thermal and visual inspection post-operation. Full compliance documentation delivered within 24 hours.

videoBreak.title: Precision Engineering. Zero Compromise.
videoBreak.text: Our proprietary cleaning systems use filtered water, controlled heat, and calibrated pressure — preserving surfaces while delivering unmatched results.

technology.label: Technology
technology.title: Bezliny Drone Systems
technology.text: Our proprietary sensor technology provides centimeter-level precision, setting a new standard for quality and significantly improving HSE performance.
